FX-SWEEP-001.says: The settings as they start: centre (50, 50), direction -30, smooth, width 50, sweep intensity 50, edge intensity 100, edge thickness 1, white, add. The band, wider than the frame, lights the whole figure, most along a line through the middle leaning left, and its edges most of all: the block's border, the soft edge and the lone red dot.

FX-SWEEP-002.says: Width 0: no band, the drawing untouched.

FX-SWEEP-003.says: Sweep intensity 0 and edge intensity 0: no light, the drawing untouched.

FX-SWEEP-004.says: Direction 0, linear, width 5, sweep intensity 100, edge intensity 0: an upright band down the middle of the frame, x = 8; columns 7 and 8 gain 0.8 of white, columns 6 and 9 0.4, and the rest is untouched.

FX-SWEEP-005.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, smooth: columns 7 and 8 gain 0.896 of white and columns 6 and 9 0.352.

FX-SWEEP-006.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, sharp: columns 6 to 9 gain all of white and columns 5 and 10, the band's soft sides, half.

FX-SWEEP-007.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, direction 90, width 3: a band lying across rows 4 and 5, which gain two thirds of white; the red dot, in row 5, is lit too.

FX-SWEEP-008.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, direction 45, width 6: the band leans right, from the lower left to the upper right through the middle.

FX-SWEEP-009.says: The edges alone: width 10000, sweep intensity 0, edge intensity 100. The block's outer ring of pixels, the soft edge and the red dot are lit about wholly white; the column beside the soft edge, half covered on its left, half; the block's middle is untouched.

FX-SWEEP-010.says: As FX-SWEEP-009, edge thickness 2.7, counted as 2: the ring two pixels deep.

FX-SWEEP-011.says: As FX-SWEEP-004 in orange #ffb040: columns 7 and 8 gain 0.8 of orange.

FX-SWEEP-012.says: As FX-SWEEP-011, composite: the band paints the drawing orange, columns 7 and 8 four fifths of the way and columns 6 and 9 two fifths, never brighter than the orange.

FX-SWEEP-013.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, cutout: only the band's light is left, white in columns 7 and 8 at 0.8 covering and in columns 6 and 9 at 0.4, the rest clear.

FX-SWEEP-014.says: As FX-SWEEP-013, edge intensity 100: the band's cut-out light is whole where it crosses the block's top and foot, the edges adding to it, held at full; inside, 0.8 as before.

FX-SWEEP-015.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, the centre keyed from (20, 50) at frame 0 to (80, 50) at frame 4, linear: the band sweeps across left to right, over the soft edge at frame 0, down the middle at frame 2 (FX-SWEEP-004) and over the red dot at frame 4.

FX-SWEEP-016.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, the sweep intensity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 past its end: frame 0 is the drawing, and frame 2 is held at 100, FX-SWEEP-004.

FX-SWEEP-017.says: As FX-SWEEP-007, direction 450, a turn and a quarter: FX-SWEEP-007 exactly.

FX-SWEEP-018.says: As FX-SWEEP-004, the layer moved three pixels right: the band moves with it, down x = 11.

FX-SWEEP-019.says: Motion Tile at 300% by 300% before it, width 7, the band's centre at (0, 50), the drawing's left edge, the layer moved eight pixels right: the band crosses from the drawing into the tile on its left, lighting the soft edge in column 10 and the tile's red dot in column 6, and nowhere else.

FX-SWEEP-020.says: Width -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SWEEP-021.says: Edge thickness 51, above 50. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SWEEP-022.says: Edge thickness 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SWEEP-023.says: Sweep intensity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
